topics.title: General Wave Properties
topics.subject: physics
outcomes: understand that energy is transferred by waves, and these may be transverse or longitudinal (k, u)
know and use the relationship between velocity, frequency, and wavelength (k, s)

body.text: A wave transfers energy from one place to another without transferring matter. Waves are described as transverse if the particles (or field) vibrate at right angles to the direction the wave travels — like a wave on a string — or longitudinal if the vibration is along the same direction as the wave travels, like sound.

Key features of a wave: amplitude (the maximum displacement from the rest position), wavelength (the distance between one point on the wave and the next identical point, such as crest to crest), frequency (the number of complete waves passing a point each second, measured in hertz, Hz), and period (the time taken for one complete wave).
The wave equation relates the speed (v), frequency (f), and wavelength (λ, the Greek letter lambda) of a wave.
